title: Adopt new Cloudflare Agents SDK features (Think, Browser tools, Observability, Codemode, Subagents)
description: Additively absorb the SDK capabilities documented in docs/new_agents_sdk/*.md without disturbing v7 specialist-delegation invariants. Pin the agents package, add observability subscribers, introduce BaseThinkAgent as a peer to BaseChatAgent (with a Think-shaped SkillProvider adapter over the existing D1-backed SkillManager), migrate WorkshopAgent as a Think proof-of-concept, layer browser tools onto CloudflareAgent and ResearchAgent, scaffold codemode behind a feature flag, and prove the Agent-level subAgent primitive with a single parallel-queries POC in ResearchAgent (WebQueryWorker subagent class).

non_negotiable_invariants: BaseChatAgent and Logger are not removed in v8.
Codemode is gated on CODEMODE_ENABLED='1'; default off.
Browser Render JSON-schema extraction in ResearchAgent is preserved.
this.subAgent() is for parent-owned ephemeral children only — NEVER used to reach another specialist. Cross-specialist dispatch stays on getPeerAgent (v7).
Skills storage backend stays D1. The new SkillProvider is an adapter over the existing SkillManager — no R2, no Octokit-backed storage, no edigraph/KV migration in v8.

phases.name: Foundation — pin SDK and scaffold infra

tasks.title: Pin agents package version + document changelog audit
tasks.description: Replace "agents": "latest" in package.json with a pinned semver (the version that ships @cloudflare/think interop, agents/browser/ai, agents/observability). Run npm install and commit the lockfile delta. Create AGENTS_PACKAGE_AUDIT.md documenting: (a) the pinned version, (b) breaking-change diff vs. previous behavior, (c) confirmation that getAgentByName, @callable, AIChatAgent still resolve. Add a CI grep step (or .agent/rules/ doc) that fails when "agents": "latest" reappears.
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n '"latest"' package.json | wc -l == 0. npx tsc --noEmit passes. AGENTS_PACKAGE_AUDIT.md exists and lists the chosen version.

tasks.title: Scaffold observability module — subscribe to SDK diagnostic channels and forward to Logger
tasks.description: Create src/backend/src/ai/observability/ with index.ts (entrypoint registerObservability(env)) and subscribers.ts (one subscribe(channel, handler) per channel). Subscribe to: 'rpc', 'rpc:error', 'state:update', 'lifecycle' (connect/disconnect/destroy), 'mcp:client:connect'/':error', 'schedule:execute'/':error'. Each handler invokes Logger.persist() with a structured payload and emits to a process-scope ring buffer (lazy-init, max 200 events) consumed later by V8-11. Wire registerObservability(env) into src/backend/src/index.ts boot path. Module-scope idempotent guard so registration survives DO restarts without leaking subscribers.
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n 'subscribe\(' src/backend/src/ai/observability returns ≥ 5. A unit test demonstrates a fake event reaching Logger.persist. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: Build BaseThinkAgent shim + Think-shaped SkillProvider adapter over the existing D1-backed SkillManager
tasks.description: Create base-think-agent.ts mirroring base-chat-agent.ts's service surface: protected logger, stateStore, hitl, peerEventsLog; abstract agentName, skills, agentInit(); public accessors getEnv/getAI/getLogger/getStateStore/getSkills/getAgentName (matching commit 8bdbdd7); @callable streamEvents and receivePeerEvent (matching BaseChatAgent); agentHealthChecks(mode) override point. Class extends Think<Env, State> from the agents SDK. Set chatRecovery: false explicitly. ALSO create skill-provider.ts: a thin adapter class implementing the Think SkillProvider interface (get/set/list shape from the R2SkillProvider example) backed by the existing SkillManager — no new caching layer, no new storage backend, just a presentation-layer wrapper. Override BaseThinkAgent.configureSession() to call session.withContext('skills', { provider: new SkillManagerSkillProvider(this.skillManager, this.skills) }) so Think handles per-turn skill injection idiomatically. Override getTools() to return the agent's existing tool registry. Export both classes from agent-support/index.ts. Do NOT modify base-chat-agent.ts. Do NOT modify SkillManager or the agentSkills D1 schema.
tasks.success_criteria: BaseThinkAgent and SkillManagerSkillProvider classes compile. rg -n 'class .*SkillProvider' src/backend/src/ai/providers/agent-support/skill-provider.ts | wc -l ≥ 1. rg -n 'withContext\(.skills.' src/backend/src/ai/providers/agent-support/base-think-agent.ts | wc -l ≥ 1. No existing agent's behavior changes (no agent extends BaseThinkAgent yet). rg -n 'extends BaseThinkAgent' src/backend/src/ai/agents returns 0 (V8-05 will be the first). Type-check passes.

tasks.title: createBrowserTools wrapper + Browser Run / Worker Loader bindings
tasks.description: Add BROWSER (Browser Run) and LOADER (Worker Loader) bindings to wrangler.jsonc per docs/new_agents_sdk/browse_web.md. Create src/backend/src/ai/tools/browser-tools.ts exporting createBrowserToolsForAgent(env) -> { browser_search, browser_execute }. Wrapper: validates env.BROWSER and env.LOADER, applies a per-call rate limit (default 10 calls/minute/agent, configurable via env.BROWSER_TOOLS_RATE_LIMIT), logs each call to a D1 browser_tool_calls table (or via Logger.persist if D1 schema extension is out of scope). Set timeout: 30000 by default. Do not import @/ai/mcp/* or @octokit/* anywhere in this file (specialist invariant).
tasks.success_criteria: createBrowserToolsForAgent compiles. Unit test confirms wrapper invokes createBrowserTools with the expected options. npx tsc --noEmit passes. wrangler.jsonc has BROWSER and LOADER bindings.

tasks.title: Codemode wrapper behind CODEMODE_ENABLED flag — fail-closed tool filter
tasks.description: Augment src/backend/src/ai/mcp/tools.ts: every MCPTool registry entry derives a safeForCodemode boolean = !needsApproval && !writesToGitHub && !mutatesCloudflare (encode the latter two as new optional fields on existing entries). Create registry-codemode-filter.ts exporting filterToolsForCodemode(tools) that returns only entries with safeForCodemode === true and throws if any incoming tool has needsApproval || writesToGitHub || mutatesCloudflare (fail closed, do not silently filter). Create codemode-tool.ts: wrapper around createCodeTool({tools, executor}) that asserts env.CODEMODE_ENABLED === '1' (throws otherwise), passes filtered tools, configures DynamicWorkerExecutor with env.LOADER, timeout: 30000, globalOutbound: null. No call sites yet.
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n 'createCodeTool\(' src/backend/src | grep -v 'tools/codemode-tool.ts' returns 0. Unit test: passing a tool with needsApproval throws. Unit test: with CODEMODE_ENABLED unset, the wrapper throws. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

phases.name: Apply scaffolding to agents (parallel-safe within phase)

tasks.title: Add Tail Worker tail_consumers and verify channel forwarding end-to-end
tasks.description: Add tail_consumers entry to wrangler.jsonc (script_name = the existing or new Tail Worker — confirm with PRD §Open Questions #2 before naming). Smoke test: deploy with --dry-run, then via wrangler dev, invoke a @callable on any agent and confirm an agents:rpc event appears in Tail Worker output (paste evidence into AGENTS_PACKAGE_AUDIT.md §SmokeEvidence).
tasks.success_criteria: wrangler.jsonc has tail_consumers configured. AGENTS_PACKAGE_AUDIT.md §SmokeEvidence cites a Tail Worker capture. npx wrangler deploy --dry-run succeeds.

tasks.title: Migrate WorkshopAgent from BaseChatAgent to BaseThinkAgent
tasks.description: Replace `extends BaseChatAgent<...>` with `extends BaseThinkAgent<...>`. Remove the custom onChatMessage override; rely on Think defaults. Move skill assembly into getSystemPrompt() / configureSession() (prefer configureSession for context blocks). Set chatRecovery: false explicitly. Preserve every existing @callable signature exactly (append-only rule). The class header comment must call out: (1) this is the v8 Think pilot, (2) @callable surface is append-only, (3) chatRecovery is intentionally false pending HITL × fiber characterization. Run a smoke test via wrangler dev: a chat round-trip completes and an existing @callable still works.
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n 'extends BaseChatAgent' src/backend/src/ai/agents/chat/WorkshopAgent | wc -l == 0. rg -n 'BaseThinkAgent' src/backend/src/ai/agents/chat/WorkshopAgent | wc -l ≥ 1. All existing WorkshopAgent tests pass. Smoke test: chat round-trip + one existing @callable invocation succeeds in wrangler dev.

tasks.title: Wire browser tools into CloudflareAgent behind BROWSER_TOOLS_ENABLED flag
tasks.description: Inside CloudflareAgent.getTools() (or equivalent tool-list assembly), append the browser tools when env.BROWSER_TOOLS_ENABLED === '1' by calling createBrowserToolsForAgent(this.env). Default off. Preserve the @callable surface (no signature changes, no new methods in this task — wiring only). Specialist invariant: this is the only chat-tier agent that may register browser tools; do not add similar wiring to CoordinatorAgent or WorkshopAgent.
tasks.success_criteria: BROWSER_TOOLS_ENABLED=1 path returns the augmented tool list; flag-off path returns the previous tool list verbatim. v7 grep guards still pass (no new MCP/Octokit imports). npx tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: ResearchAgent.interactiveScrape — append-only @callable for unstructured page exploration
tasks.description: Create methods/browser-execute.ts exporting interactiveScrapeImpl(agent, args: { url: string; instruction: string; perCallTimeoutMs?: number }) -> Promise<{ summary: string; rawJsLog?: string }>. Implementation: build browser_execute via createBrowserToolsForAgent(this.env), invoke the tool with an LLM prompt that combines `url` + `instruction`, return the captured output. Add a single @callable interactiveScrape on ResearchAgent that dynamic-imports and delegates. **Do not modify** ResearchAgent/methods/github.ts or methods/web-search.ts — Browser Render JSON-schema extraction stays untouched. Add a clear JSDoc on the new method explaining: 'Use BrowserRenderApi.getJson for structured extraction; use this for unstructured exploration only.'
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n '@callable' src/backend/src/ai/agents/backend/ResearchAgent | grep 'interactiveScrape' | wc -l == 1. methods/github.ts and methods/web-search.ts diff is empty. npx tsc --noEmit passes.

tasks.title: EngineerAgent.experimentalCodemodeOrchestrate — single gated call site
tasks.description: Create methods/experimental-codemode.ts exporting experimentalCodemodeOrchestrateImpl(agent, args). Builds a strictly read-only tool subset (codebase grep, file-read, MCP agenticSearch via getPeerAgent — confirmed list TBD per PRD §Open Questions #5). Passes through src/backend/src/ai/tools/codemode-tool.ts (which validates CODEMODE_ENABLED and rejects approval-gated/write/mutate tools). When CODEMODE_ENABLED !== '1', return { status: 'disabled', reason: 'CODEMODE_ENABLED flag is off' } — never throw. Add a single @callable experimentalCodemodeOrchestrate on EngineerAgent. Mark Beta in JSDoc with a link to docs/new_agents_sdk/codemode.md and the PRD's Codemode footgun risk. **No production call site.**
tasks.success_criteria: rg -n '@callable' src/backend/src/ai/agents/backend/EngineerAgent | grep 'experimentalCodemodeOrchestrate' | wc -l == 1. With CODEMODE_ENABLED unset, calling the method returns { status: 'disabled' }. v7 grep guards still pass.

tasks.title: Bridge observability ring buffer into health report
tasks.description: Create metrics-tap.ts exporting captureRecentEvents(): { recentRpcErrors: ObservabilityEvent[]; recentMcpEvents: ObservabilityEvent[] } that drains (peeks, does not mutate) the observability ring buffer from V8-02. Modify health/runner.ts so that after collecting Layer 2/3 checks, it appends the metrics-tap output to the HealthReport. Update health/types.ts to add optional recentRpcErrors and recentMcpEvents fields on HealthReport. Do not break the existing report shape — fields are optional and additive.
tasks.success_criteria: An existing health report invocation now includes recentRpcErrors and recentMcpEvents fields. The fields are populated when at least one event has been captured. npx tsc --noEmit passes. Existing health tests pass.

tasks.title: verify-v8.sh harness + final docs sweep
tasks.description: Create scripts/verify-v8.sh running the full PRD §Verification block end-to-end (typecheck, v7 invariant greps, v8 specific guards, append-only @callable greps, wrangler --dry-run). Exit non-zero on any failure. Update PRD §Open Questions to reflect resolved decisions (pinned version, Tail Worker name, rate limit, codemode tool list). No code changes outside scripts/.
tasks.success_criteria: bash scripts/verify-v8.sh exits 0. PRD §Open Questions has resolved entries replaced with their decisions.
